LuLu activates an Odigo robot media network across 30 UAE stores

The live network uses 62 mobile robots for shopper assistance and advertising tailored to individual stores.

Aletihad ↗2 October 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1

A network now in operation

LuLu Retail and Kody Middle East Holding signed a retail-media partnership in Abu Dhabi. The network puts 62 AI-enabled Odigo robots across 30 LuLu stores in the United Arab Emirates. Aletihad reports that it is live, providing a concrete deployment count rather than treating an earlier rollout ambition as a newly completed fleet.

Shopper help and mobile advertising

Odigo moves autonomously through stores to support navigation, product discovery and promotions. Campaigns can be updated in real time and tailored by location, store or market. The arrangement combines customer assistance with advertising near the point of purchase and is available to brands, agencies and media buyers.

Results still to measure

The deployment offers retailers an example of robot use beyond moving goods. However, the report does not disclose advertising revenue, conversion rates or effects on store congestion. The installed fleet is evidence of adoption; it should be distinguished from unproven claims about marketing effectiveness.
